mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a family room addition and a sunroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A family room addition is typically a fully integrated, insulated space designed to be a permanent extension of your home's living area, complete with HVAC, standard windows, and finishes. In contrast, a sunroom is often designed to maximize natural light with extensive glass, may not be fully insulated for year-round use, and might have simpler foundation requirements. The key trade-off lies in year-round comfort and full integration versus abundant natural light and potentially lower cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: A family room is a fully integrated, insulated living space, while a sunroom typically emphasizes natural light with more glass and may not be fully climate-controlled.
